def factor_tail_intraday_excursion_volume_tool(df):
    """Accumulates downside intraday excursions weighted by volume surge using active volume regime tool."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    downside_excursion = ((prev_close - df_copy["low"]) / prev_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    stress_component = downside_excursion * vol_ratio
    factor = stress_component.rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum()
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_tail_intraday_excursion_volume_tool")
description: Mutation of tail_risk_002: preserves the core panic-selling stress accumulation (downside intraday excursion weighted by volume surge). Replaces the 60-day simple moving average volume ratio with the responsive continuous EMA-based volume ratio from alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime (window=20). This improves volume confirmation timeliness, targeting MI and drawdown robustness while retaining RankIC/ICIR stability from the parent mechanism. The factor remains a single-stock raw signal; cross-sectional normalization is not applied.
